# Shubham Maheshwari

Shubham Maheshwari is a Dubai-Indian actor. He best known for his role as Gat Patil in the television series We Were Liars.
Career
Maheshwari began his acting career in Haven Dust, in 2021, and the Amazon Prime Video series We Were Liars, playing Gat Patil.
Personal life
Maheshwari was born in Dubai to Indian immigrant parents and spent his early life in the United Arab Emirates. He later moved to Canada for higher studies, pursuing an economics degree at the University of British Columbia, where he discovered the open casting call that launched his acting career.
